title: Garrison / Scheduler and queue
description: Queue depth per agent and harness, claims, lease requests and waits, compile time, blocked runs, and lease expirations.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: harness
list.label: Harness
list.description: Harness type. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Runs Pending or Queued, cluster-wide.

targets.expr: sum(max by (status, tenant, agent, harness) (garrison_queue_depth{status=~"Pending|Queued", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"})) or on() vector(0)

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Leased or running
panels.description: Runs Leased, Running, or Cancelling, cluster-wide.

targets.expr: sum(max by (status, tenant, agent, harness) (garrison_queue_depth{status=~"Leased|Running|Cancelling", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"})) or on() vector(0)

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.description: Queued runs no Ready worker can run right now.

panels.title: Queue depth by agent and status
panels.description: Unfinished runs per agent and status, cluster-wide.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, status) (max by (status, tenant, agent, harness) (garrison_queue_depth{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"})) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Queue depth by harness
panels.description: Unfinished runs per harness, cluster-wide.

targets.expr: sum by (harness) (max by (status, tenant, agent, harness) (garrison_queue_depth{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"})) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Claims by result (per minute)
panels.description: Claim attempts: won, lost (another node claimed first), limit (deployment at its concurrency limit).

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Claim duration
panels.description: Time to find, claim, and compile runs inside one lease request.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, result) (rate(garrison_scheduler_claim_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "result", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, result) (rate(garrison_scheduler_claim_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "result", "none", "", "")

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Lease requests by result (per minute)
panels.description: Worker lease requests answered, by result.

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Lease wait (long poll)
panels.description: How long lease requests waited before they were answered.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, result) (rate(garrison_scheduler_lease_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "result", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, result) (rate(garrison_scheduler_lease_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "result", "none", "", "")

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Compile duration by harness
panels.description: Time to compile a claimed run into an execution spec.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_compile_duration_seconds_bucket{harness=~"$harness", agent=~"$agent"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_compile_duration_seconds_bucket{harness=~"$harness", agent=~"$agent"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Wakeups, lease renewals, and the claim lock
Queue wakeups by source (per minute)
panels.description: Lease long polls woken by a queue notification versus the fallback poll interval. Many poll wakeups with few claims means idle polling; many notify wakeups that claim nothing means broad notifications.

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Lease renewals by result (per minute)
panels.description: Run leases extended by worker heartbeats. Lost renewals tell the worker to stop a run whose lease moved on.

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Deployment claim lock wait
panels.description: Time claims waited for the per-deployment concurrency lock (Postgresql). A rising p95 means claims of one deployment are serialized behind each other.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_scheduler_deployment_lock_wait_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_scheduler_deployment_lock_wait_seconds_bucket{}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
